backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor for the GenMitra print platform, defining data types (Product, Template, Order, Cart, User) and stable storage maps, plus authentication (login/logout), role-based access control, and CRUD operations for products, templates, orders, cart, pincodes, and addresses.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module that copies the old actor's users map and re-seeds the default admin and user accounts into the new actor state.
feature_evidence.json: Empty feature evidence report JSON file with no features listed.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document summarizing each frontend source file's purpose and notable implementation details, covering hooks, pages, and components of the React frontend.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS entry point that defines CSS custom properties for light and dark theme color tokens (background, foreground, primary, etc.) used throughout the UI.
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML shell for the React SPA, mounting the app into a root div and loading the main TypeScript entry point.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app component that sets up TanStack Router with all public, layout, and admin routes, including an AdminGuard wrapper for admin-only pages and an OriginHandler for cross-origin iframe messaging.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminGuard: Route guard component that redirects unauthenticated users to the login page and re-authenticates admin credentials against the backend actor on page refresh before rendering children.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminLayou: Admin panel shell component providing a responsive sidebar with navigation links, a logo, and a logout button wrapping all admin page content.
Customer reviews section displaying a paginated, sortable list of review cards with star ratings, reviewer name, date, and verified purchase badge.
frontend/src/components/FAQSection.tsx: Accordion-style FAQ section with a two-column layout, rendering eight questions with smooth expand/collapse animations using local state per item.
frontend/src/components/FeaturedProducts: Displays a grid of featured products (with hardcoded demo fallbacks) fetched via React Query, supporting add-to-cart and wishlist actions with authentication checks and toast notifications.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Renders the site footer with navigation link columns, contact info, social media icons, and a copyright bar.
frontend/src/components/HeroBanner.tsx: Full-width hero section with a background image, headline, CTA buttons, and summary stats, navigating to the shop on click.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Main app shell providing a sticky header with logo, category navigation, cart count, auth controls, a promo bar, and a footer wrapping all page content.
frontend/src/components/OffersBanner.tsx: Promotional banner section displaying a discount offer with a coupon code and a Shop Now CTA button over a background image.
frontend/src/components/ProductCategoryG: Renders a responsive grid of product category cards with images that navigate to the filtered shop page on click.
frontend/src/components/ShopFramesBySize: Interactive size-selector section that highlights a chosen frame size and navigates to the shop when a size button is clicked.
frontend/src/components/TrustFeatures.ts: Displays four trust-signal cards (Google rating, delivery, satisfaction guarantee, support) in a responsive grid layout.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React Query hook that creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous ICP backend actor based on the current Internet Identity, invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminSession.ts: Hook managing admin session state via sessionStorage, exposing login, logout, and credential retrieval helpers.
frontend/src/hooks/useAuth.ts: Composite auth hook combining Internet Identity login/logout with user profile, role, and admin status queries from the backend.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Context provider and hook implementing Internet Identity authentication using DFINITY's AuthClient, managing identity state, login/logout flow, and delegation validity.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Collection of React Query hooks (queries and mutations) for all backend interactions including user profiles, roles, products, templates, orders, and cart operations.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet defining a purple-based design system with OKLCH CSS custom properties for light/dark themes, Tailwind layers, and utility classes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app wrapped with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminDashboardP: Renders the admin dashboard with summary stat cards (orders, earnings, users, products) and a table of the five most recent orders, with a link to the full orders list.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminSettingsPa: Admin settings page for managing delivery pincodes, allowing admins to add or remove 6-digit pincodes via forms with toast notifications.
frontend/src/pages/admin/CustomerManagem: Admin page that lists all registered customers in a table with their profile info and expandable order history fetched from backend queries.
frontend/src/pages/admin/OrderManagement: Admin order management page supporting status updates, custom image downloads, and production file generation/download for all orders with filtering by status.
frontend/src/pages/admin/ProductManageme: Admin product management page with a modal form for creating, editing, and deleting products including image compression and size option management.
frontend/src/pages/admin/TemplateManagem: Admin template management page with a modal form for creating, editing, and deleting print templates including compressed image and preview uploads.
frontend/src/pages/CartPage.tsx: Displays the shopping cart with item removal, a multi-step flow (cart → address → payment → success), pincode availability check, and order placement via COD or Online payment.
frontend/src/pages/CheckoutPage.tsx: Full checkout page with address form pre-filled from saved address, multiple payment method selection (COD/UPI/CARD/NETBANKING), a mock payment modal, and order submission with redirect to confirmation.
frontend/src/pages/CreateAccountPage.tsx: Account creation form collecting username and optional email, triggering Internet Identity login and navigating to the home page on success.
frontend/src/pages/EditorPage.tsx: Canvas-based photo editor allowing users to upload an image, apply template overlays, zoom/drag the image, select a size, and add the customized product to the cart.
frontend/src/pages/ForgotPasswordPage.ts: Forgot-password page with an email input that simulates sending a reset link and shows a confirmation state after submission.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Home page that composes multiple section components (hero, categories, featured products, offers, FAQ, reviews), conditionally hiding most sections when a category filter is active.
frontend/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx: Renders a login page supporting both admin (username/password form) and user (Internet Identity) authentication modes, navigating to the appropriate route on success.
frontend/src/pages/MyOrdersPage.tsx: Displays a list of the authenticated user's orders as clickable cards with status badges, showing a loading skeleton or empty state when appropriate.
frontend/src/pages/OrderConfirmationPage: Shows a post-purchase confirmation screen with order details (ID, items, total, status) fetched by order ID, plus navigation buttons to track the order or return home.
frontend/src/pages/OrderDetailPage.tsx: Renders a detailed view of a single order including a visual step-by-step status tracker, item list with images, and order metadata fetched via the order ID route param.
frontend/src/pages/ProductDetailPage.tsx: Displays a product's image, description, size selector, and quantity controls, allowing authenticated users to add the item to their cart or navigate to the customization editor.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility module for extracting, persisting, and cleaning URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routes. Supports sessionStorage-backed persistence and safe removal of sensitive params (e.g., admin tokens) from the address bar.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration enabling dark mode, custom design tokens (colors via OKLCH, fonts, shadows, border radii), and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Project state snapshot (version 29) describing the full-stack online printing/gift platform architecture, tech stack, known issues (CORS, admin auth, save functionality), and implemented features.
